body: As I pick up the request slip, its stiff paper and the word "REFUSED" on it make my heart sink. I notice the faint scent of ink and the worn edges, a sign of years of use and countless attempts at retrieval. My mind begins racing with what this means for my project. I think about the archive's archives manager, her stern demeanor, and the countless times I've had to plead my cause. Fear starts to rise as I wonder if I've been too late.
